structural_change: DRIVE-S81-GUNIT N32 (10-20, tree S81.STA.PAR.3): native census of the 10-18 RTL FAILED 1,046 drivers > 32 (max 2,110: wq write enables 2,110, beat number cbn 1,030, reset relay 639, gq2 431, SC data ad/bd 64, the f12 LAT-5 adder cut regs 56-69, y 33, cfw 33, 420 comb sort/merge selects 33-200). Restructured, same function / ports / edges: 9 kept wq/row copies + 4 kept SC data copies at the pins, per entry / half-word kept write decode (dsdv_l1f_wdec), 19 kept beat-number copies (one read slice each), ve-local NATIVE-32 adder (ot_s81sl_ve_qadd LAT 4) behind a kept twin operand register (= LAT 5), key from y (bits 0-15) / y2 (16-31), lane valid twice, dsdv_gunit_sel_n32 sort/merge (4 kept compare copies, one per record-bit slice), 4 kept gather request copies, 9 kept reply-select copies, 13 valid-only reset regions. W pins spread over the full W face (10-18 B gate: W pins in the upper third, GRT overflow 176 above the SRAM). | S81U-GUNIT-L1 (10-17): new E-side leaf L1f of dsdv_gunit (hardened once, 4 instances, q-agnostic: q-specific enables / hits on their own wires): SC store slice (112 x fp32), bias in 2 x ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 (read one beat ahead, no added edge), 16 bias adds, key, 2 x bitonic sort8 + merge8 at two compare-exchanges per registered stage (13,564 generic flops < 15k), gather of the chosen scores. Flop-first / flop-last; no ready / credit. | S81U-GUNIT-L1b (10-17): NATIVE-2 pin rules (relayed reset, pin flops) + one-compare-deep select stages + LAT-5 bias add (+1 edge) + registered gather decode; clk / rst_n pins at the S-face centre (pin_ranges; the gate put clk at the SW corner: TT spread 132.6 ps) | PL-GULEAF (10-18): route.cts_sink extra -no_obstruction_aware (s81 gather leaf 10-14 precedent): the gate @103f9cf73 measured boundary pin-flop spread TT 278.1..391.9 ps (113.8 > 80) with the H-tree detouring around the abutted 2-SRAM stack in the tile centre | S81-GUSEQ (10-18): -no_obstruction_aware fixed the spread (gate @712ed0fe8 boundary TT 284..329 = 45 / FF 41 ps) but trial GRT overflowed 117,519 (M2 89% / M3 91% / M4 83%): synth std area 27,193 um2 in a 216 x 216 core minus the 2-SRAM stack = ~71% std util. Outline -> 259.2 x 259.2 (6 x 6 lattice; = the dsdv_gunit_lp col-B pitch, so the four L1f tiles abut with no gap) -> ~46% util; clk / rst_n stay at the S-face centre; io_hold_margin 0.025 (kit rule 10-18). | variant B (S81-GUSEQ 10-18): 259.2 x 302.4 (~39% util) gated in parallel with 259.2 x 259.2; the cheaper one that clears GRT overflow 0 is submitted.

job.purpose: S81.STA.PAR.3: native-32 L1f (router select front, 4 per gunit) to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native census).

pin_regs.reason: Source-registered: every input lands in a flop at the pin and every output is a flop (dsdv_gunit_l* input/output flops, dsdv_gunit_pass feedthroughs, ot_dsdv_vstop's own flops); recipe pin_regs would add an unpriced stage on the router's critical path and on every rung hop.
